description: Synthetic, committed, and network-free. Six compact cases preserve retrieval shapes that previously regressed: query-anchored excerpts, body-less heading representatives, locator exclusion, duplicate-view fusion, honest abstention, bounded natural-language breadth, and named relevance-floor suppression. The prose and queries are inventions, not a reconstruction of any user's corpus or a calibration source for production defaults.

baseline.note: Synthetic regression guard. Every fixture is written to exhibit a retrieval shape, never to manufacture or calibrate a particular relevance value. The relevance floor's measured calibration lives in a ranking unit test; this pack only verifies the observable mechanics of withholding and naming a below-floor quoted example.
